title: Major Fossil Discovery in China Reveals New Secrets About Mysterious Hominin Ancestors
caption:
New fossil evidence from China shows Homo erectus thrived in tropical rainforests long after scientists thought they had disappeared. These ancient ancestors were far more adaptable to changing landscapes than previously recorded.

Source: Sciencealert - Major Fossil Discovery in China Reveals New Secrets About Mysterious Hominin Ancestors
